free_tier_limits: Free: 30,000 credits/mo (~6,000 min on small Docker), 5 active users, 30 concurrent jobs, 1 GB network, 2 GB storage. Linux OSS: up to 400,000 credits/mo. Check pricing for current numbers.
rate_limits: Limits exist and vary by endpoint (no fixed public req/s). HTTP 429 with Retry-After; use RateLimit-*/X-RateLimit-* headers and exponential backoff. See API developer’s guide.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL “unknown” wrong; Verifier B partly right. Official pricing (https://circleci.com/pricing/) and credits docs (https://circleci.com/docs/guides/plans-pricing/credits/): Free = 30,000 credits/mo (~6,000 build min on small Docker), 5 users, 30× concurrency, 1 GB network, 2 GB storage; OSS Linux up to 400,000 credits/mo. Not “6,000 build credits.” rate_limits: ORIGINAL “not published” incomplete; Verifier B’s “15–50 req/s” not in official docs. Developer’s guide (https://circleci.com/docs/guides/toolkit/api-developers-guide/) documents rate limiting, 429 + Retry-After, RateLimit/X-RateLimit headers, limits vary by endpoint—no fixed public numeric rate.
